description: HS256 on a set whose only oct key has alg HS384 fails with NoMatchingKey; decided by ADR 0054 §2.2 (JWK alg): a member alg present must equal the selector's, and HS384 is not HS256, so the key stays bound to the alg it names (§7, RFC 8725 §3.1) and zero members match (§4); outcome hand-derived from the ADR 0054 text (conformance/tools/jwk-oracle/specs/select.json), never computed by polyjose
